title: Twenty Autumns and One Empty Chair
subtitle: 风俗传统 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 风俗传统（历史社会与文化·传统习俗）
meta: 主题语境：风俗传统（历史社会与文化·传统习俗）　|　核心词汇：custom　|　正文 336 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 custom 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1946 my great-uncle ① kept a custom that no neighbour in the village would have understood, and he said the keeping was the whole of the year. The ② custom, meaning the observance and not the habit, ran twenty autumns and stayed unexplained; a custom, he said, is the only thing in a village that is judged by how long it is left unquestioned.

Every ③ custom in that valley had the same empty chair against it, and the ④ custom at the end, meaning the one they kept for the absent and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A custom, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to remember; my great-uncle said the remembering is the part that fills twenty autumns.

My mother meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the custom was the whole of the household, meaning the habit and not the observance. The ⑥ custom, meaning the habit and not any of that, is the only thing in a household that everybody follows and nobody explains; custom, she said, is either something you keep or the only word that means both an observance and a habit. He said the habit is the part they remember.

By 1955 the ⑦ custom had become a line in a notebook, and the notebook had become an argument about the empty chair. The ⑧ custom of the whole thing, my great-uncle wrote in October, was one valley and twenty autumns of remembering; custom, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to remember. She said the remembering was never mentioned.

The ⑨ custom I remember is the one at the end, which was last observed in 1973 and is still described as the oldest in the valley. A ⑩ custom, my grandmother said in 1975, is the only thing that improves by being remembered; every custom, she said, is a habit that has agreed to look like an observance. She said the habit was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 风俗；习俗（指一个村子或山谷里通行的那一种）
B. n. 风俗（指那种仪式性的遵行本身，与那个习惯相对）
C. 固定搭配：keep a custom 遵守（保持）一种风俗
D. n. 风俗（指为不在场的人留着的那一套）
E. n. 风俗；习俗（抽象总称，指一整个山谷的守俗之道）
F. n. 风俗（指笔记本里写到、被记下的那一种）
G. n. 习惯（指一家人日常照做的那一种）
H. n. 习惯（抽象总称，指人人照做却无人解释的规矩）

items.q: kept a custom that no neighbour in the village would have understood
The custom, meaning the observance and not the habit
the custom was the whole of the household
the custom had become a line in a notebook
The custom of the whole thing

answers.why: keep a custom 意为“遵守（保持）一种风俗”，1946 年伯祖父守着一种村里没有一位邻居能理解的风俗。
custom 意为“风俗”，指那种仪式性的遵行本身而不是那个习惯，它延续了二十个秋天而从未被解释。
custom 意为“风俗”，指那条山谷里每一种风俗，每一种都对着同一把空椅子。
custom 意为“风俗”，指为不在场的人留着的那一套，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
custom 意为“习惯”，指一家人日常照做的那一种，母亲说这个习惯就是这一家人的全部。
custom 意为“习惯”，指人人照做却无人解释的规矩而不是别的，是一家人里人人都照做、却无人说明的东西。
custom 意为“风俗”，指笔记本里写到、被记下的那一种，到 1955 年这种风俗成了笔记本里的一行。
custom 意为“风俗、习俗”，伯祖父十月写道，整件事的习俗是一条山谷和二十个秋天的记念。
custom 意为“风俗”，我记得的是末尾那一种，1973 年最后一次遵行，至今仍被说成山谷里最古老的。
custom 为抽象总称，祖母 1975 年说，一种风俗是唯一会因为被记起而变得更好的东西。
